pattern: ^SELECT .+ AS Departure_Date, IFNULL\(.*\), FROM .+ LEFT JOIN .+ ON .+\.treatment_id IS NOT NULL
correction: Select DISTINCT T1.\<arrival\_date\_column\> , T1.\<departure\_date\_column\> FROM Dogs AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.dog\_id = T2.dog\_id

metadata.description: This rule corrects queries that incorrectly select columns and use the wrong join condition
